item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyig ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can gyis/ lho phyogs rgyal mo ngo mtshar tsha ba rong / gnas mchog bkra shis spungs ri nas gter las drangs te/ mdangs ldan g.yung drung gling du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o//
